serviceAccess.datum: Required technical access; removable deck and garden-side service access, not extra water area.

method.rootSpaceAllowance: At least 1 m from trunk centre to parcel boundary and modeled ground obstacles, furniture and stepping stones; illustrative allowance, not an actual nursery root-ball measurement.
method.crownRule: Full 5 m nominal crowns may cross the parcel edge. Their complete volumes receive screening/shade credit; the selected outer crown overhang is explicitly disclosed.
method.objective: 0.6 mean + 0.3 minimum among seated living room, standing living room, jacuzzi and garden, plus 0.1 weighted coverage of 17 views.
method.outsideCreditSensitivity: Also count only intersections whose first tree entry lies inside the parcel. This diagnoses dependence on outside crown volume; it is not a pruning specification.
method.selectedRounding: The compact default is an intentional mild adjustment of the published grove: outer pine +0.50 m east, rear inner pine +0.20 m east/+0.05 m rear, middle pine unchanged. Connected overlapping crowns and rear grouping take priority over the search visibility score. The wider search-derived arrangement remains a separately named comparison. Every reported ray is recomputed.
method.verification: Every reported visibility count checked against the complete analyzeVisibility engine.
method.caveat: Bounded comparison of dense ideal crown shapes. No claim of a global optimum or complete real-world screening.

optimisticUnion.description: Union of all accepted grid/refined crowns ignoring spacing and tree count. A sampled-region diagnostic, not a feasible design or continuous upper bound.
